questions.prompt: In the data → information → knowledge pipeline, what comes immediately after data?
According to the BONSAI proposal, the project partnership includes 17 partners from how many member states?
Which statement best matches BONSAI's overall objective?
options: Make flood-defence systems in tidal estuaries of North-West Europe more resilient to climate change
Replace all regional flood authorities with one European agency
Develop a single commercial water-monitoring product
questions.answer: Make flood-defence systems in tidal estuaries of North-West Europe more resilient to climate change

questions.prompt: Why does the BONSAI proposal emphasise transnational cooperation?
options: Estuarine systems and climate change cross borders, creating opportunities for mutual learning
Every partner uses exactly the same local conditions
Only one country has experience with flood resilience
The project is designed to avoid sharing lessons between regions
questions.answer: Estuarine systems and climate change cross borders, creating opportunities for mutual learning

questions.prompt: What turns organised information into knowledge in the Unit 1 lesson?
options: Interpreting information so it can support understanding, learning and decisions
Collecting more raw values without context
Removing the source and context from records
Keeping information isolated within one partner organisation
questions.answer: Interpreting information so it can support understanding, learning and decisions
